title: Replace Silhouette Shapes with Rectangles and Glassy In-Content Chips
description: The UI design system shifts away from the silhouette shape (rectangles with chips outside, producing gap shapes between elements) towards plain rectangles where chips sit inside the content, layered on top of it with a different, glassy background through which the content stays visible. Migrate the complete monorepo end to end: schemas, shared geometry, React, wgpu, TUI and print targets, all consumers, tests, fixtures, stories and docs, so UI elements compose without gap shapes.
summary: Round 2 of the shift to rectangles with glassy in-content chips is done across web, sites, OS renderer, wgpu, TUI, Python clips, clip presentation and LaTeX. Chip glass and tint come from one token source (CSS, Rust, Python, LaTeX). Fixed on the way: covered tab text, incomplete active borders, duplicated select arrows, menu focus ring, canvas stopping at the bands, drag previews, unreadable semantic text inks, embedded video id clash, missing staffage clip, stale tests. Verified: UI 1713 tests, OS renderer 3594 (7 tests and 2 suites environmental), new Storybook frame visuals 9 of 9, every touched Rust group 0 failures in its last run (some not rerun after the ink change), print on macOS, clip tests and stills (bim retirement unfinished, 4 primary-energy scale tests red). Not verified: running OS shell, wgpu on screen, D3D12 and Vulkan, full clip renders. Details and open points: summary.md.

interactions.summary: Replaced the window silhouette model (chips outside, gap cutouts, polygon clip) with window-frame-geometry/v1 (one rectangle, content edge to edge, glass chips inside) across React, styling, wgpu renderer, OS Rust dock and Shell, TUI, print and products. Old names are gone except in absence-check tests. Verified: UI React 1629 passed (5 need Playwright Chromium), typechecks clean, Rust frame, border, renderer, paint-laws 110, CardStack 29, dock laws 76 pass. Open: mounted-layout 1 failure and Shell test crates chrome-4 (4) and input-1 (49) fail on other agents' in-flight job, value-arena and document-lease work; D3D12/Vulkan, Storybook, Python visuals and a live OS shell check were not run. See summary.md in the ticket folder.
